name: Lark API Usage Summary
query:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(reference_doctype, 'System / Auth') as `reference_doctype`,
    COALESCE(reference_name, 'Global') as `reference_name`,
    COUNT(*) as `total_calls`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as `success_calls`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as `failed_calls`
FROM `tabLark API Log` 
WHERE MONTH(creation) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE()) AND YEAR(creation) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY reference_doctype, reference_name 
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
